falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 76% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug assumed a higher low structure; a break below 4,800 would violate the August 2024 bottom's key support level and invalidate the bottoming pattern thesis

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff score of 41 suggests controlled de-risking; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic-level volatility that contradicts the 'HOLD' signal's assumption of non-capitulation market conditions

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury spread inverts by more than -50 basis points (i.e., 2Y yield exceeds 10Y yield by 0.50% or more)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Deepening inversion beyond -50bps would signal acute recession risk/liquidity stress, breaking the macro stability assumption embedded in the UNKNOWN verdict and pattern match to a non-recessionary August 2024 bottom

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
